elements.element: Renewal must be either solely by mutual written agreement or through automatic renewal.
elements.evidence: Section 4.1 expressly provides for automatic renewal.

elements.element: If the Agreement renews automatically, each renewal term must be 12 months.
elements.evidence: Each automatic renewal is for an additional one-year period.

elements.element: If the Agreement renews automatically, Customer must be able to prevent renewal by giving 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: Either Party, which includes the Company as Customer, may prevent the renewal by providing 30 days' written notice.

elements.element: If the Agreement renews automatically, Vendor must remind Customer 60 days before each renewal.
elements.evidence: Section 4.1.1 requires HDI to notify the Company at least 60 days before each renewal.

elements.element: If the Agreement renews automatically, renewal price increases must be capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
elements.evidence: Section 4.1.1 expressly caps any renewal-period price increase at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
Section 4.1 provides for automatic one-year renewals on each anniversary.

elements.element: The non-renewal notice window must be no more than 60 days.
elements.evidence: The clause requires 30 days' written notice, which is no more than 60 days.

elements.element: Renewal price increases must not exceed 5%.
elements.evidence: The lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap necessarily limits any renewal price increase to no more than 3%, and therefore no more than 5%.

result.reason: The operative language satisfies the automatic-renewal branch of the preferred position and all fallback requirements. It is not strictly minimal because changing the existing notice right from 90 to 30 days for “either Party” also shortens HDI's notice period, although the preferred position only requires a 30-day Customer opt-out. The use of general termination language rather than renewal-specific non-renewal language may also permit termination during a term, but this structure existed in the original clause. The redline otherwise preserves the term structure and introduces no contradiction.
